name: GDPVal
intro: GDPval是一个评估AI模型在真实世界中具有经济价值任务表现的基准测试。它涵盖了美国劳工统计局针对44个职业的大部分工作活动，这些职业来自对美国GDP贡献最大的9个行业。任务是根据平均拥有14年经验的行业专业人士的代表性工作构建的。该基准测试还提供了一个包含220个任务的黄金子集和公共自动化评分服务。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注
intro_en: GDPVal is a benchmark for evaluating AI models' performance on economically valuable tasks in the real world. It covers most work activities for 44 occupations from the 9 industries contributing most to the US GDP, based on data from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics. Tasks are constructed to represent work performed by industry professionals with an average of 14 years of experience. The benchmark also provides a gold subset of 220 tasks and a public automated scoring service.
scale_en: 44 items professions, 220 items golden subset tasks

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.04374. GDPVal first selects U.S. sectors contributing more than 5 percent of GDP and then chooses predominantly digital, high-wage occupations using BLS, O*NET, and employment/wage data, yielding 44 occupations across 9 sectors. Industry professionals with at least 4 years of experience, and an average of 14 years, create tasks from real work products; each task contains a request, reference files, and a deliverable. The full 1,320-task set undergoes automated screening and multiple rounds of human expert review with iterative revisions for realism and quality. The open 220-task gold subset is graded through blinded pairwise comparisons by occupation experts, producing deliverable-quality win rates against human expert work, with an experimental automated grader released for the gold subset.
